About EmbroidHub

EmbroidHub publishes a free introduction to Mandarin tones and presents Mastering Mandarin Tones: A Clear Guide for English Speakers.

About the ebook author

Ricardo Rodrigues Filho is the author of this 61-page English-language PDF. It covers Mandarin tone patterns, written practice, tone pairs and tone sandhi. You can review the contents before deciding whether it fits your studies.

Our free learning resources

The Mandarin tones practice guide provides an introductory explanation, a visual chart and a suggested routine. References link to educational and research sources for further listening and reading. Written explanations support listening and speaking practice; individual progress depends on practice and feedback.
